Hi Darren,

Thank you for that, it is genuinely appreciated. We would always rather tell you where things really stand than let a date slide quietly.

When your Magic Miner 40T lands, I am your contact for the technical side: first boot, getting it on Wi-Fi or Ethernet, finding its IP and web UI, pool setup (stratum URL, worker name, password), and tuning for heat and noise. It is a simple unit to bring up, and most people are hashing within a few minutes of plugging in. If anything looks odd on the first start, send me a photo of the screen or the web UI and I will read it from there.

One thing worth sorting before it arrives: decide which pool you want to point it at and create your worker there, so you only have to paste the details in on the day.

Looking forward to getting you mining.

Best regards,
Hal, HeliumDeploy Technical Support
